about: The source model of a Janelia H5J file (spec/zarrify/h5j.md <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/h5j.md>): an HDF5 file, read by the HDF5 parser under the HDF5 source model (schema/hdf5.json), whose channels are MP4 files, each read by the MP4 parser under the MP4 source model (schema/mp4.json). This model holds the checks of the H5J layout itself; a parser checks it while it parses, and projections read a valid IR and check nothing.

elements.about: The IR of the HDF5 file (schema/hdf5.json), but that the contiguous data of each channel the profile presents, the dataset Channels/Channel_<n>, is a struct `data` of the same extent instead of a data element: the elements of its MP4 file's IR (schema/mp4.json) but its root, their extents moved by the dataset's address.

given.reasons: each other channel's name and reason, joined by "; "
